# Skandiora Immigration

> Skandiora Immigration is an education guidance consultancy with offices in Kochi and Trivandrum (Kerala) and Chennai (Tamil Nadu), India. It helps students and families choose and apply for study in India or abroad — including MBBS abroad, domestic admissions, credit transfer, education loans, language training, attestation, accommodation and visas — starting by understanding the student's academic background, ambitions, budget and eligibility rather than simply processing an application. Skandiora Immigration does not guarantee admission, loan approval or visa outcomes; these depend on the institution, lender or immigration authority.

## Main services

- [Student Visa / Study Abroad](/services/study-abroad): University, course and destination guidance plus student visa preparation. Popular destinations: UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Dubai. Europe: Ireland, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Malta, Lithuania, Latvia, Bulgaria, Moldova, Hungary, Albania, Cyprus, Finland, Sweden, Switzerland, Romania and Bosnia. Also Singapore, Mauritius and other suitable destinations.
- [Domestic Admission](/services/study-in-india): College and course admission guidance within India, across Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
- [Credit Transfer](/services/credit-transfer): Pathways for students with a discontinued degree, B.Tech, diploma or postgraduate course to continue their studies by transferring eligible credits.
- [Attestation](/services/attestation): Personal, educational and commercial document attestation for international use. Enquiries are handled directly on WhatsApp.
- [Visa Services](/services/visa-assistance): Visiting, spouse, family and dependent visas, and guidance on PR options and other visa categories. Consultations are requested directly on WhatsApp. Student visas are covered under Study Abroad.

## Supporting services

- [MBBS Abroad](/services/mbbs-abroad): Medical admission guidance for Tajikistan, Timor-Leste, Georgia, Uzbekistan, Moldova, Bulgaria, Kazakhstan, Russia, China, the Philippines, South Korea and Barbados (USA). A specialised branch of the study-abroad service.
- [Education Loan Assistance](/services/education-loan): Understanding financing options and preparing a loan-ready application.
- [Language Training](/services/language-training): IELTS, TOEFL, OET and German exam preparation.
- [Accommodation Assistance](/services/accommodation): Exploring student accommodation options at the destination before travel.

## About the company

- [About](/about): Skandiora Immigration's founder, vision, mission and approach.
- Founder: Ashwin R. Nair — more than six years in education consultancy; MBA from Cardiff Metropolitan University (UK); graduate of Rajagiri College of Management and Applied Sciences (Kochi). He stays personally involved in each student's journey.
- Vision: Every education decision made with clarity — for the student, not just the admission.
- Mission: To understand each student first, explain their options in India and abroad honestly, and guide them through every step that follows — admission, visa, finance and settling in.
- Approach, in three steps: (1) Understand — the student's academic journey, ambitions, strengths, circumstances, finances and future pathways; (2) Explore — suitable courses, institutions, countries and alternative pathways; (3) Prepare — admission, visa, attestation, education loans, language preparation and accommodation.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Skandiora Immigration is a guidance and documentation-support consultancy, not a university, lender or government authority — it does not issue admissions, loans or visas itself.
- The first step is a free assessment of the student's profile.
